title: DGMS (Tech) Circular No. 03 of 2010 — Strata Control and Monitoring Plan (SCAMP)
text: Requires all underground coal mines to formulate and implement a comprehensive Strata Control and Monitoring Plan (SCAMP). Formally incorporates geotechnical classification (RMR by CMRI-ISM), dual-height tell-tales for bed separation measurement, continuous convergence monitoring, and trigger action response plans (TARP) when convergence rates exceed critical safety limits.

title: DGMS (Tech) Circular No. 06 of 2013 — Quality and Testing of Roof Bolts
text: Prescribes standard specifications and routine destructive and non-destructive anchorage testing of resin-grouted roof bolts. Mandates minimum short-encapsulation pull load of 8 tonnes after 30 minutes and 12-15 tonnes after 24 hours. Pull tests must be conducted on at least 10% of installed bolts and documented in statutory registers.

title: DGMS Circular No. 02 of 2018 — Elimination of Uncemented / Loose Props & Mechanised Bolting
text: Stresses the total replacement of timber props by mechanized steel roof bolting with high-tensile rebar and resin encapsulation. Prohibits deploying workers within 6 metres of the freshly blasted face prior to temporary support erection or roof bolting rig operation.

title: DGMS Circular No. 04 of 2022 — Scientific Strata Management in Metal Mines
text: Issues geotechnical guidelines for metalliferous underground operations including sub-level open stoping and cut-and-fill. Emphasizes acoustic emission monitoring, microseismic hazard zoning, and shotcreting with wire mesh in shear zones.
